Notebook Restricted-Mode bypass via mermaid render. Upstream vulnerable file extensions/mermaid-markdown-features/preview-src/notebook/index.ts (temp.innerHTML = result) does not exist in Code Editor. Shipped mermaid renderer extensions/mermaid-chat-features/src/chatOutputRenderer.ts escapes source via escapeHtmlText and renders in a strict nonce-CSP webview using mermaid SVG output (extensions/mermaid-chat-features/chat-webview-src/mermaidWebview.ts uses textContent + mermaid.run, no innerHTML of untrusted HTML). The markdown notebook renderer (extensions/markdown-language-features/notebook/index.ts) already gates untrusted HTML through DOMPurify.sanitize. No equivalent unsafe innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML pattern present.

RCE via attacker-controlled parentOrigin in webWorkerExtensionHostIframe.html. Already mitigated by the existing web-server/webview.diff (repo commit 4d1c2d6): the non-validated path forces parentOrigin = window.origin and never reads the attacker-supplied searchParams value there, while the hostname-validation path binds parentOrigin into the parentOriginHash subdomain check that rejects any mismatched origin. Equivalent to upstream's explicit parentOrigin rejection; not double-applied.
